site.name: CyberPulseAcademy
site.description: Free, accessible, non-commercial cyber security study platform. Realistic hands-on scenario exercises for SOC analysts, incident responders, threat hunters, GRC analysts, pentesters, cloud engineers and students.
search.label: Search the catalog
search.noResultsHint: Try a shorter term, an ATT&CK identifier such as T1059, or browse a catalog instead.
filter.none: No topics match the current filters.
batch.heading: Choose an exercise batch
batch.intro: Three independent batches per topic. Each one covers the same subject from a different angle, so doing all three is a much better test than repeating one.
batch.1.label: Batch 1
batch.2.label: Batch 2
batch.3.label: Batch 3
batch.notPublished: Not published yet, help us build it
batch.loadingHint: This can take a moment on a slow connection.
batch.loadError.title: This exercise failed to load
batch.loadError.body: The batch file did not open. It may be missing, renamed, or blocked by your network. Nothing was lost.
batch.timeout.title: The exercise is taking too long
batch.timeout.body: It did not finish loading in time. Your connection may be slow or the file may be unavailable.
identity.title: Who is studying?
identity.intro: CyberPulseAcademy keeps a name and a country so that scores are yours and so the public statistics can show which countries are studying what. No email, no account, no tracking.
identity.nameHint: 2 to 32 characters. Letters, digits, underscore, hyphen and dot only. Not your real name unless you want it to be.
identity.nameRequired: Please enter a name of at least 2 characters.
identity.nameInvalid: Use letters, digits, underscore, hyphen or dot only.
identity.consent: I agree to the Privacy Policy and to anonymous usage statistics.
identity.consentRequired: Please accept the Privacy Policy to continue.
identity.deleted: Your identity and local statistics were deleted from this browser.
identity.needFirst: Set your name and country before starting an exercise. Reading is always open.
identity.saved: Saved. Your scores will be recorded on this device.
stats.title: Statistics
stats.localNotice: Local mode. You are the only data source on this device. These numbers never leave your browser and nobody else can see them.
stats.offNotice: Statistics collection is switched off for this deployment. Nothing is recorded anywhere, including on your own device.
stats.remoteNotice: Anonymous, aggregated statistics reported to a server operated by the site owner.
stats.privacyNote: Statistics are anonymous and aggregated. No personal data is sold or shared. Read the Privacy Policy.
stats.empty.title: Nothing recorded yet
stats.empty.body: Complete an exercise batch and your results will appear here. In local mode only this browser is counted.
stats.error.title: Statistics could not be loaded
stats.error.body: The request failed or timed out. Nothing is broken on your device.
coverage.title: Coverage dashboard
coverage.lede: Every topic, and how many of its three exercise batches have been published. This is the contribution roadmap: the gaps are the work that is left.
coverage.cta: Pick any topic with a gap and generate a missing batch with the prompt in CONTRIBUTING.md. You do not need permission.
exam.identityNeeded: Set your name and country first
exam.recent: Your recent attempts on this device
exam.noAttempts: No attempts recorded on this device yet.
share.title: Share
share.template: I scored {pct} on the {title} exam, {count} questions, {difficulty} difficulty.
share.templateNoScore: {title} on CyberPulseAcademy: {count} practice questions at {difficulty} difficulty.
share.unsupported: Your browser cannot share directly, so use one of the options below.
support.title: Support CyberPulseAcademy
support.thanksBody: Your support pays for the time that goes into writing new exercise batches. Every euro is accounted for on this page.
support.disclaimer: Voluntary personal support. Not a purchase. Not tax-deductible.
support.processedBy: Donations are processed by PayPal. CyberPulseAcademy never sees or stores your card details.
footer.disclaimer: CyberPulseAcademy is an independent, community-run study resource. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by MITRE, ISC2, CompTIA, ISACA, OffSec, EC-Council, or any vendor.
footer.attackTrademark: ATT&CK is a registered trademark of The MITRE Corporation.
consent.title: A note on storage
consent.body: CyberPulseAcademy stores your chosen name, country, theme and exercise scores in this browser only. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.
storage.warning: This browser is blocking local storage, so progress cannot be saved between visits. Everything still works for this session.
theme.toggle: Switch between dark and light theme
error.generic.title: Something went wrong
error.generic.body: The page could not finish loading its data. You can retry, or browse a catalog directly.
error.catalog.title: The catalog could not be loaded
error.catalog.body: data/catalog.json did not load. If you opened this file directly from disk, serve the folder over HTTP instead: python -m http.server 8000
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: That address does not exist on CyberPulseAcademy. It may have been renamed, or the link may be mistyped.
home.continueNone: No attempts recorded on this device yet. Pick any catalog below to begin.
contribute.title: Contribute a batch
contribute.body: Every topic needs three batches. If a topic shows a gap, generate the missing batch with the prompt in CONTRIBUTING.md and open a pull request. You do not need permission and you do not need to be an expert.
report.content: Report an issue with this content
